rationale: Event cleanliness now uses origin-cycle failure/assumption windows, so a mismatch at the halt origin blocks credit; applied to stretch too. Timeout-enable no longer excuses STOP/SCL release during halt; only prior observed timeout status or disable does, so later pulses cannot justify retroactively. A completed NACK recovery lacking status witness is reported unresolved (pending), not pass. Added selftests for first-NACK byte mismatch, premature timeout STOP, and missing-status non-pass; existing tests kept.
